{{Otheruses|Rex}}
'''Rexutu the Unconquerable''' was a [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] warrior leader during their battles with the [[Battalion/Legends|Battalions]] of [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He led the Taungs during their famous last stand against the Zhell, immortalized in the ninth chapter of the ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]'' epic poem.
